1use crate::encode::{MAX_STAGE, PASS_ACTION_ID};
2use crate::legal::{ActionDesc, DecisionKind};
3use crate::state::{AttackType, ModifierKind};
4
5use super::GameEnv;
6
7const FRONT_ROW_SLOTS: [usize; 3] = [0, 1, 2];
8
9#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]
10struct StageSlotPublicScore {
11    occupied: bool,
12    has_attacked: bool,
13    power: i32,
14    effective_soul: i32,
15    side_attack_allowed: bool,
16}
17
18#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
19struct PublicBoardScore {
20    self_level_count: i32,
21    self_clock_count: i32,
22    self_stage: [StageSlotPublicScore; MAX_STAGE],
23    opponent_stage: [StageSlotPublicScore; MAX_STAGE],
24    choice_page_start: i32,
25    choice_total: i32,
26}
27
28fn slot_preference(slot: usize) -> i64 {
29    match slot {
30        0 => 20,
31        1 => 30,
32        2 => 15,
33        3 => 8,
34        4 => 6,
35        _ => 0,
36    }
37}
38
39fn prefer_lower(value: u8) -> i64 {
40    -(value as i64)
41}
42
43impl GameEnv {
44    pub(crate) fn choose_heuristic_public_action_id(&mut self) -> u16 {
45        let Some(decision) = self.decision.as_ref() else {
46            return PASS_ACTION_ID as u16;
47        };
48        let player = decision.player as usize;
49        if self.action_ids_cache().is_empty() {
50            return PASS_ACTION_ID as u16;
51        }
52        self.refresh_slot_power_cache();
53        let board = self.heuristic_public_board(player);
54        let mut best_action_id = PASS_ACTION_ID as u16;
55        let mut best_score: Option<(i64, i64, i64, i64, i64)> = None;
56        for &action_id in self.action_ids_cache() {
57            let score = self.heuristic_public_score_action(action_id as usize, &board);
58            let candidate = (score.0, score.1, score.2, score.3, -(action_id as i64));
59            if best_score.is_none_or(|current| candidate > current) {
60                best_score = Some(candidate);
61                best_action_id = action_id;
62            }
63        }
64        best_action_id
65    }
66
67    fn heuristic_public_board(&mut self, player: usize) -> PublicBoardScore {
68        let opponent = 1usize.saturating_sub(player);
69        let (choice_page_start, choice_total) =
70            match (self.decision.as_ref(), self.state.turn.choice.as_ref()) {
71                (Some(decision), Some(choice)) if decision.kind == DecisionKind::Choice => {
72                    (choice.page_start as i32, choice.total_candidates as i32)
73                }
74                _ => (0, 0),
75            };
76        PublicBoardScore {
77            self_level_count: self.state.players[player].level.len() as i32,
78            self_clock_count: self.state.players[player].clock.len() as i32,
79            self_stage: self.heuristic_public_stage(player),
80            opponent_stage: self.heuristic_public_stage(opponent),
81            choice_page_start,
82            choice_total,
83        }
84    }
85
86    fn heuristic_public_stage(&mut self, player: usize) -> [StageSlotPublicScore; MAX_STAGE] {
87        let mut slot_card_ids = [0u32; MAX_STAGE];
88        let mut slot_soul_mods = [0i32; MAX_STAGE];
89        let mut slot_side_attack_allowed = [false; MAX_STAGE];
90        for slot in 0..MAX_STAGE {
91            let slot_state = &self.state.players[player].stage[slot];
92            let card_id = slot_state.card.map(|card| card.id).unwrap_or(0);
93            slot_card_ids[slot] = card_id;
94            slot_side_attack_allowed[slot] = card_id != 0;
95        }
96        let use_derived_attack = self.state.turn.derived_attack.is_some();
97        if !self.state.modifiers.is_empty() {
98            for modifier in &self.state.modifiers {
99                if modifier.target_player as usize != player {
100                    continue;
101                }
102                let slot = modifier.target_slot as usize;
103                if slot >= MAX_STAGE {
104                    continue;
105                }
106                let card_id = slot_card_ids[slot];
107                if card_id == 0 || modifier.target_card != card_id {
108                    continue;
109                }
110                match modifier.kind {
111                    ModifierKind::Soul => {
112                        slot_soul_mods[slot] =
113                            slot_soul_mods[slot].saturating_add(modifier.magnitude);
114                    }
115                    ModifierKind::CannotSideAttack
116                        if !use_derived_attack && modifier.magnitude != 0 =>
117                    {
118                        slot_side_attack_allowed[slot] = false;
119                    }
120                    _ => {}
121                }
122            }
123        }
124        if let Some(derived) = self.state.turn.derived_attack.as_ref() {
125            for (slot, card_id) in slot_card_ids.iter().enumerate() {
126                if *card_id == 0 {
127                    continue;
128                }
129                slot_side_attack_allowed[slot] =
130                    !derived.per_player[player][slot].cannot_side_attack;
131            }
132        }
133
134        let mut stage = [StageSlotPublicScore::default(); MAX_STAGE];
135        for slot in 0..MAX_STAGE {
136            let (card_inst, has_attacked) = {
137                let slot_state = &self.state.players[player].stage[slot];
138                (slot_state.card, slot_state.has_attacked)
139            };
140            let Some(card_inst) = card_inst else {
141                continue;
142            };
143            let soul = self.db.soul_by_id(card_inst.id) as i32;
144            stage[slot] = StageSlotPublicScore {
145                occupied: true,
146                has_attacked,
147                power: self.compute_slot_power(player, slot),
148                effective_soul: soul.saturating_add(slot_soul_mods[slot]).max(0),
149                side_attack_allowed: slot_side_attack_allowed[slot],
150            };
151        }
152        stage
153    }
154
155    fn heuristic_public_score_action(
156        &self,
157        action_id: usize,
158        board: &PublicBoardScore,
159    ) -> (i64, i64, i64, i64) {
160        let Some(action) = self.action_for_id(action_id) else {
161            return (-1000, 0, 0, 0);
162        };
163        match action {
164            ActionDesc::Attack { slot, attack_type } => (
165                900,
166                self.heuristic_public_score_attack(slot as usize, attack_type, board),
167                0,
168                0,
169            ),
170            ActionDesc::EncorePay { slot } => (
171                700,
172                self.heuristic_public_score_slot(slot as usize, &board.self_stage),
173                0,
174                0,
175            ),
176            ActionDesc::MainPlayCharacter {
177                hand_index,
178                stage_slot,
179            } => (
180                650,
181                self.heuristic_public_score_play_character(stage_slot as usize, board),
182                prefer_lower(hand_index),
183                0,
184            ),
185            ActionDesc::ClimaxPlay { hand_index } => (
186                550,
187                self.heuristic_public_score_climax(board),
188                prefer_lower(hand_index),
189                0,
190            ),
191            ActionDesc::Clock { hand_index } => (
192                500,
193                self.heuristic_public_score_clock(board),
194                prefer_lower(hand_index),
195                0,
196            ),
197            ActionDesc::MainPlayEvent { hand_index } => (320, 10, prefer_lower(hand_index), 0),
198            ActionDesc::ChoiceSelect { index } => (300, prefer_lower(index), 0, 0),
199            ActionDesc::LevelUp { index } => (290, prefer_lower(index), 0, 0),
200            ActionDesc::TriggerOrder { index } => (280, prefer_lower(index), 0, 0),
201            ActionDesc::MulliganConfirm => (260, 0, 0, 0),
202            ActionDesc::MainMove { from_slot, to_slot } => (
203                120,
204                self.heuristic_public_score_move(from_slot as usize, to_slot as usize, board),
205                0,
206                0,
207            ),
208            ActionDesc::ChoiceNextPage => {
209                let remaining = (board.choice_total - (board.choice_page_start + 16)).max(0) as i64;
210                (170, remaining, 0, 0)
211            }
212            ActionDesc::ChoicePrevPage => (170, board.choice_page_start.max(0) as i64, 0, 0),
213            ActionDesc::Pass => (160, 0, 0, 0),
214            ActionDesc::MulliganSelect { hand_index } => (120, prefer_lower(hand_index), 0, 0),
215            ActionDesc::EncoreDecline { slot } => (
216                110,
217                self.heuristic_public_score_slot(slot as usize, &board.self_stage),
218                0,
219                0,
220            ),
221            ActionDesc::Concede => (-1000, 0, 0, 0),
222            _ => (-1000, 0, 0, 0),
223        }
224    }
225
226    fn heuristic_public_score_attack(
227        &self,
228        slot: usize,
229        attack_type: AttackType,
230        board: &PublicBoardScore,
231    ) -> i64 {
232        let attacker = board.self_stage.get(slot).copied().unwrap_or_default();
233        let defender = board.opponent_stage.get(slot).copied().unwrap_or_default();
234        if !attacker.occupied {
235            return -1000;
236        }
237        let type_score = match attack_type {
238            AttackType::Direct => {
239                if defender.occupied {
240                    15
241                } else {
242                    60
243                }
244            }
245            AttackType::Frontal => {
246                if attacker.power >= defender.power {
247                    45
248                } else {
249                    25
250                }
251            }
252            AttackType::Side => {
253                if attacker.side_attack_allowed {
254                    40
255                } else {
256                    5
257                }
258            }
259        };
260        type_score
261            + slot_preference(slot)
262            + (attacker.effective_soul.max(0) as i64) * 4
263            + (attacker.power.max(0) as i64) / 1000
264    }
265
266    fn heuristic_public_score_play_character(&self, slot: usize, board: &PublicBoardScore) -> i64 {
267        let stage = board.self_stage.get(slot).copied().unwrap_or_default();
268        if stage.occupied {
269            return -1000;
270        }
271        let bonus = slot_preference(slot);
272        if FRONT_ROW_SLOTS.contains(&slot) {
273            return 40 + bonus;
274        }
275        if slot < MAX_STAGE {
276            return 20 + bonus;
277        }
278        bonus
279    }
280
281    fn heuristic_public_score_move(
282        &self,
283        from_slot: usize,
284        to_slot: usize,
285        board: &PublicBoardScore,
286    ) -> i64 {
287        let origin = board.self_stage.get(from_slot).copied().unwrap_or_default();
288        let target = board.self_stage.get(to_slot).copied().unwrap_or_default();
289        if !origin.occupied || target.occupied {
290            return -1000;
291        }
292        let mut bonus = 0;
293        if from_slot >= 3 && FRONT_ROW_SLOTS.contains(&to_slot) {
294            bonus += 30;
295        }
296        if to_slot == 1 && from_slot != 1 {
297            bonus += 15;
298        }
299        (slot_preference(to_slot) - slot_preference(from_slot)) + bonus
300    }
301
302    fn heuristic_public_score_climax(&self, board: &PublicBoardScore) -> i64 {
303        let attackers = FRONT_ROW_SLOTS
304            .iter()
305            .filter(|&&slot| {
306                let stage = board.self_stage[slot];
307                stage.occupied && !stage.has_attacked
308            })
309            .count() as i64;
310        let defenders = FRONT_ROW_SLOTS
311            .iter()
312            .filter(|&&slot| board.opponent_stage[slot].occupied)
313            .count() as i64;
314        attackers * 10 + defenders * 4 + if attackers > 0 { 10 } else { -20 }
315    }
316
317    fn heuristic_public_score_clock(&self, board: &PublicBoardScore) -> i64 {
318        if board.self_level_count <= 0 && board.self_clock_count < 6 {
319            return (40 - board.self_clock_count) as i64;
320        }
321        10
322    }
323
324    fn heuristic_public_score_slot(
325        &self,
326        slot: usize,
327        stage: &[StageSlotPublicScore; MAX_STAGE],
328    ) -> i64 {
329        let slot_state = stage.get(slot).copied().unwrap_or_default();
330        slot_preference(slot) + (slot_state.power.max(0) as i64) / 1000
331    }
332}
